# FEMIC

> Agent-facing index for FEMIC. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home, with the guide and reference sections.
- [Guides](guides/index.html): task and workflow guides, including the instance and data lanes.
- [Technical contracts](reference/contracts/index.html): the compact invariants and runtime seams.
- [API reference](reference/api/index.html): public modules, functions, and types.
- [CLI reference](reference/cli.html): command groups and options.

## Carbon

- [Carbon package workflow](guides/carbon-overview.html): the producer-side map from package to WS4, HWP, and GCBM.
- [Carbon package export](guides/carbon-export.html): build, validate, and hand off the static package.
- [Fertilization response and emissions](guides/fertilization-audit.html): the public TIPSY response and thesis factors.
- [Harvested wood product lifecycle](guides/hwp-lifecycle.html): split, half-life, displacement, EOL, and system accounts.
- [GCBM walltowall export](guides/gcbm-export.html): the separate bridge lane and its limits.
- [Forest carbon domain contract](reference/contracts/carbon-domain.html): the authoritative package schema and engine boundary.
